title: Thai-Style Curry Rice Bowl
description: A flavorful and easy-to-make rice bowl dish, perfect for a quick lunch or dinner. The combination of savory curry and pillowy rice is a match made in heaven.
instructions: Heat the curry paste in a saucepan over medium heat.
Add the curry powder and stir for 1 minute.
Add the water and bring to a boil.
Reduce heat to low and simmer for 5 minutes.
Prepare the rice according to package instructions.
Fluff the cooked rice with a fork and stir in the curry sauce.
Serve in a bowl and garnish with chopped cilantro (if using).
Optional: top with toasted rice or other garnishes.
